recap.text: Carl and Donut ally with Team Retribution against the Bloc. Ferdinand, mayor of Shanty Town, holds the warlord interface. Sir Ferdinand triggers a live-feed blackout for the dungeon. Spies use scrolls to turn a trench into acid, and Semuru dwarves in tunnels attack war mages. Juice Box turns into an Unwashed and warns the viewers. Team Retribution and the Princess Posse are the last two teams.

beats.headline: The defending team names itself
beats.text: Carl and Donut come onto the ninth floor at Larracos, at the start of a sixty-hour ceasefire, and the defending side already has a name it chose for itself. Cascadia runs through the rules. The crawlers ally with it against the Bloc, which is every other faction on the board.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut enter Larracos during a sixty-hour ceasefire and ally Cascadia against the Bloc.

beats.headline: Ferdinand holds the interface
beats.text: Juice Box and Louis are reunited, and he is visibly uneasy about the marriage. Then she lays out the practical problem: Ferdinand is mayor of Shanty Town, just outside Larracos, and he holds the warlord interface for the team, because he is technically from outside. Nothing this side of the wall moves without a cat's cooperation. Drick is the adjutant.
beats.gist: Juice Box and Louis reunite; Ferdinand holds the warlord interface for Team Retribution in Shanty Town.

beats.headline: A blackout for everyone
beats.text: Sir Ferdinand proposes an emergency action item, in language unsuitable for the broadcast, because teams on other floors are cheating: nobody in the dungeon, including the guests partying in the centipede on the eighteenth floor, may watch any outside feed for the rest of the game. It is approved. Effective immediately, everyone in the dungeon is under a live-feed blackout. Carl had not wanted to spend one of his own action items on it. Victory notes that it is a first.
beats.gist: Sir Ferdinand proposes an emergency action item to blackout all outside feeds because other teams cheat.

beats.headline: The acid trench
beats.text: Team Retribution's part in the assault is two spies and some scrolls. The NPCs were handed scrolls that change the chemistry of water in a container, instead of alcohol for some of their bars. So the spies drop a water scroll into the enemy's empty middle trench, turn it to acid, and cover the whole thing with an illusion. The enemy, confused and scared, fall back from the first trench and jump into it blind. The scout, an NPC porsuk bartender, goes up almost twenty levels.
beats.gist: Team Retribution uses spies to turn a middle trench into acid and cover it with an illusion.

beats.headline: The dwarves under the field
beats.text: A mage's dispel clears the Posse's smoke, and the ground under Carl, Donut, Rosetta, Simoom and the dead king's yak gives way. They land a dozen feet down among white dots outlined in green: Team Retribution's Semuru dwarves, two dozen of them, in a fortified tunnel big enough for cars. Juice Box had said passages like this cross the whole floor for the dwarven diggers. The dwarves re-form the roof and go after the war mages who fell in further down the line. Not so tough with the magic turned off.
beats.gist: A mage's dispel drops Carl, Donut, Rosetta, Simoom and a yak into a tunnel of Semuru dwarves.

beats.headline: It is coming for you all
beats.text: Odette arrives to replace Chaco, Cascadia comes apart on air, and Carl spends an emergency action item to shut the communication loophole the other teams have been using. Then Juice Box turns into an Unwashed in front of the cameras and tells everyone watching that it is coming for them all.
beats.gist: Odette replaces Chaco, Cascadia breaks on air, and Carl shuts a communication loophole using an emergency action item.

beats.headline: Two teams left
beats.text: Epitome Tagg is dead and the Dream is beaten, which leaves the Princess Posse and Team Retribution on the board. A team of NPCs was put on this floor to be fodder. It has outlasted eight galactic powers.
beats.gist: Team Retribution and the Princess Posse remain after the Dream is beaten and Epitome Tagg dies.
